title: Suricatoos — Remediation Payload: config_hardening
description: The payload of a remediation job whose type is config_hardening (ADR-0010): ONE security setting to enforce on a Windows endpoint, keyed by the CIS rule it satisfies (cite only the rule NUMBER — ADR-0009). source selects how the handler reads and writes it. The job queue treats the payload as opaque; only the executor handler interprets it. Non-fabrication: rule_ref/key/value originate from the attested hardening finding, never from AI.

rule_ref.description: CIS rule number only, e.g. 18.9.x (a number is fact, not copyrightable prose)

source.description: how the setting is read/written on the endpoint

key.description: registry path / policy name the setting lives under
